checks.description: Verifies that the user has the required permissions to execute flows in Copado Functions.
checks.fixGuidance: Assign the Flow Run permission set to the integration user.
checks.name: Flow User Permission

checks.description: Verifies that the Copado managed package is installed.
checks.fixGuidance: Copado Deployer v25.0 is the minimum version recommended to ensure a successful migration.
checks.name: Copado

checks.description: Verifies that the DX Extension Bundle records are created.
checks.fixGuidance: Update the extension bundle from Copado Extensions page.
checks.name: SFDX Extension Bundle

checks.description: Verifies that the "Flow Tests" and "Apex Tests" Extension Configuration are created.
checks.fixGuidance: "Flow Tests" or "Apex Tests" Extension Configurations are not created.
checks.impact: Flow Tests and Apex Tests extension configurations are created
checks.name: Extension Configurations

checks.description: Verifies that Salesforce DX package is installed.
checks.fixGuidance: Copado DX v7.0 is the minimum version recommended to ensure a successful migration.
checks.name: Salesforce DX

checks.description: Verifies that Copado Quality Tools package is installed.
checks.fixGuidance: Install the Copado Quality Tools package from AppExchange.
checks.name: Quality Tools

checks.description: Verifies that Copado Functions are enabled and have sufficient credits.
checks.fixGuidance: Contact your CSM or Copado Support to get Functions enabled in your organization.
checks.impact: Copado Functions are enabled, installed, and have credits
checks.name: Functions Enabled

checks.description: Verifies that Functions Named Credential is configured in Settings.
checks.fixGuidance: Contact your CSM or Copado Support to ensure the Function Named Credential is created in your organization.
checks.impact: Functions Named Credential is valid and configured
checks.name: Functions Named Credential

checks.description: Verifies that the user has appropriate permission set assignments.
checks.fixGuidance: The following permission sets are required for the user running the migration: Copado User, Copado Functions Admin, Copado Job Engine, Git Snapshot Admin, Execute Automations, CMC SFDX Admin, Persona Management.
checks.impact: Persona Management permission set should be assigned
checks.name: Permission Sets (Assignments)

checks.description: Verifies the running user has the Copado Admin License assigned in the Copado License Manager.
checks.fixGuidance: Ensure the running user has the Copado Admin License assigned in the Copado License Manager.
checks.impact: Copado Admin License is assigned to the user
checks.name: User License

checks.description: Verifies that API Key is created under Account Summary.
checks.fixGuidance: Create an API Key under Account Summary.
checks.name: API Key

checks.description: Validates that the Action picklist values are correct in the organization.
checks.fixGuidance: Ensure the "copado__Action__c" field in the "copado__Pipeline_Action__c" object, and the "Copado_Actions" Global Value Set has the following values: Promotion, PromotionDeployment, Commit, CreatePackage, CreatePackageVersion, PublishPackageVersion, ImportPackage, Rollback, TakeSnapshot, PackageDistribution, SubmitUserStories, InsightAppSec.
checks.name: Picklist Values

checks.description: Validates that the Platform picklist includes the SFDX value.
checks.fixGuidance: Add the SFDX value to the Platform picklist.
checks.name: Platform Picklist Values

checks.description: Verifies that the lightning record pages are activated.
checks.fixGuidance: Activate the required Lightning record pages for Pipeline, Promotion, and User Story.
checks.name: Lightning Pages

checks.description: Verifies governance org credential is accessible.
checks.name: Governance Org Credential

checks.description: Verifies if the Salesforce Session Settings Timeout Value is 2 hours or higher.
checks.fixGuidance: Increase the value to at least 2 hours.
checks.name: Org Session Timeout

checks.description: Verifies that there are no active custom triggers or validations in ContentVersion, ContentDocument, or ContentDocumentLink.
checks.fixGuidance: Make sure the triggers or validations don't block the creation or update of files and attachments in the org.
checks.impact: No active validations or triggers were found on Salesforce file objects
checks.name: Validations in File and Attachment

checks.description: Verifies that there are no active custom triggers or validations in User Stories and Promotions.
checks.fixGuidance: Make sure the triggers or validations don't block the update of user stories and promotions.
checks.impact: No active validations or triggers were found on Finish Migration objects
checks.name: Validations in Stories and Promotions
